newsitem.title: UK: BRITISH POLICE TO QUESTION SOCCER STAR GASCOIGNE.
newsitem.headline: BRITISH POLICE TO QUESTION SOCCER STAR GASCOIGNE.

text.p: England soccer player Paul Gascoigne will be questioned about an alleged assault on a young woman, British police said on Tuesday.
"Police have received an allegation of common assault on a young woman on 12 March at 7.30 in the evening," said a police spokeswoman.
"There have been no arrests at this stage and inquiries are continuing."

Newspaper reports alleged the England and Glasgow Rangers midfielder, known as "Gazza" to his fans, slapped the unidentified 27-year-old woman in the face as he leaned out of a car window during a night out with friends.
